result.topic_en: Formula-only notes on Dirichlet series with logarithmic factors, the logarithm of the Euler product, the integral representation of the zeta function, the partial-fraction expansion of the cotangent, and a derivation of the functional equation of the zeta function.

methods.what: Euler–Maclaurin-type remainder formula for the Dirichlet series sum of (log n)^ν / n^{s+1}
Analogous formula for the series with (log log n)^m (log n)^ν, using derivatives of the Gamma function
Logarithm of the Euler product and its derivative
Möbius-type inversion expressing the prime sum through φ(qs)
Functional equation of the zeta function (asymmetric form)
Integral representation of Gamma times zeta
Partial fraction expansion of the reciprocal of a function over its roots
Partial fraction expansion of cot x from the product for sin x
Contour integral representation of zeta, evaluated termwise to derive the functional equation
Legendre duplication formula for the Gamma function
Symmetric form of the functional equation of the zeta function
